'''Malata''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TUR" /> located in the [[Malata system/Legends|Malata system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a part of the [[Rakatan Archipelago]], a fragmented group of unaligned planets [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by tribes of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] after the collapse of the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]<ref name="TUR" /> around [[25,200 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

The tribe that colonized Malata also brought its [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] there, which included [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]],<ref name="TUR" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Reproduction/Legends|Overbreeding]] among the Wookiees of Malata, however, [[Mutant|led]] to sickly genetic deformities, such as them being [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] and stoop-shouldered with long front [[Tooth/Legends|incisors]] meant for chewing on [[Tree/Legends|timber]] thickets.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malata was introduced in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a [[2010]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
